facts.value: This module aims to convey insights into the theory and method of the social sciences (economics, law and/or social sciences) and their engagement with East and Southeast Asia. Students become familiar with questions relevant to Asia from these disciplines and various methods of dealing with them.
facts.original_value: This module, directed in particular towards students with a degree in cultural sciences, aims to convey insights into the theory and method of the social sciences (economics, law and / or social sciences) and their engagement with East and Southeast Asia. By using examples, students become familiar with questions relevant to Asia from these disciplines and various methods of dealing with them.

facts.value: Students attend two seminars from the category 'Introduction to the social sciences' of the Master's programme of Modern East Asian Studies (MEAS).
